deadline.value: Application deadline is December 1 (opens September 1; fee waiver requests close November 22, 2026).
deadline.quote: Online Application Opens September 1 ... Application Deadline December 1

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists specifically for Neuroscience, and the GRE is not required for WCGS Neuroscience applicants.
gre_subject.quote: Applicants are not required to take the Graduate Record Examination (GRE).

also.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Prior advisor arrangement is not required; students complete at least three 2–3 month lab rotations in Year 1 before choosing a thesis advisor.
supervisor.quote: No. You may reach out to faculty members of interest during the application cycle, but this is not a requirement. Lab rotations in your first and second years will assist you in identifying faculty mentors/PIs who align with your research interests.

also.quote: Students are expected to complete at least three rotations, each lasting two to three months, but students can complete additional rotations before choosing a thesis advisor (major sponsor).

funding.value: All WCGS PhD students receive a guaranteed annual stipend ($55,620 in New York City; $40,000 for the Houston Methodist cohort in 2026–2027), full-tuition scholarship covering tuition and fees, and comprehensive health insurance.
funding.quote: Each Weill Cornell Graduate School of Medical Sciences (WCGS) PhD student receives a generous annual stipend intended to support basic living expenses; the stipend is $55,620 ($40,000 for our Houston Methodist Hospital cohort due to cost of living differential) for the 2026-2027 academic year. Each student accepted to the PhD degree-granting programs is awarded a full-tuition scholarship, which includes all tuition, fees and health insurance.

entry_route.value: A baccalaureate (bachelor’s) degree from an accredited college or university is required; no master’s degree is required.
entry_route.quote: To be considered for admission, applicants must have a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university and must show evidence of your potential for advanced research as indicated by your scholastic records, training, and experience.

notes: WCGS Neuroscience also operates a Houston Methodist Academic Institute track (separate application if applying to both NYC and Houston; stipend $40,000 in Houston vs $55,620 in NYC). Non-US transcripts require NACES course-by-course evaluation.
